Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

SPECIFICATION f OR 
INSTRUMENTS TABLE. MAYO'S TYPE

1. 8cop«— Dimensional and other requirements for Mayo*s type Instrument table. 

2. Matarlali 

2.1 Tubei — Shall be at tlven In !•! of IS : 4033-1968 'General requirements for hospital furniture* or of 
aluminium filoy of luluEle composltlofi* 

2.2 M-^ Mild steel or aluminium alloy of suitable composition. 

2«3 Top— Shall be according to 2.2(a) and 2.2(b) of IS: 4033-1968, or aluminium alloy of Designation 
HS30 or HS40 of ^S 737*1965 ^ Specification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloys, sheet and strip 
(for general engineering purposes ) '. 

2.4 Costori — Shall be according to Designation HNS0x20x6PG of IS: 4034- 1968 'Specification for 
cattors for hosplui equipment '. 

3. Shape and DImenalone — As shown In Fig. I. 

4. Manufacture and Workmanahip 

4.1 The table shall have a frame work of tubes, as shown In Fig. I. It shall have four castors for the smooth 
aievement of the table. 

4.2 The stem of the cable shall have telescopic arrangement for raising and lowering table top. It shall 
have a locking arrangement by providing holes for heights between 830 to 1 270 mm. 

4.3 The inside of the stem and locking lug shall be free from burrs and sharp edges to allow the rod to 
operate snnoothly. 

4.4 The sheet metal top shall be welded to the supporting tube which shall be welded to the stem tube at 
right angles to each other. Any other arrangement for fixing the top shall be as agreed to between the 
purchaser and the manufacturer but in either case, the construction obtained shall be sturdy. 

4.5 The removable type of tray shall have handles on both sides and shall be placed on the metal top 
as shown in Fig. I. 

4.6 The rest of the details shall be according to 4.1 of IS : 4033*1968. 

4.7 The castors may have locking arrangement and shall be swivel and ball bearing type in accordance with 
15:4034-1968. 

5. Finish — The rod of the telescopic arrangement on which the table top is mounted and the cable top, if 
made of mild steel shall be plated chromium over nickel In accordance with Service Grade 2 of IS : 1068- 
1968 ' Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel ( first ftvision)\ 
In case these are made of aluminium alloy, they shall be anodized in accordance with IS : 1868* 1968 ' SpecU 
ficatlon for anodic coatings on aluminium (first reWs/on)'. The table top if made of stainless steel 
shall be passlvated. Other components shall be painted In accordance with 5 of IS : 4033-1968. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Adhesion Test — Shall be according to 6.1.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

6.2 Performonct Test — Shall be according to 6.1.2 of IS : 4033-1968 and the performance shall be deter- 
mined by putting an additional load of 3 kg spread all over the tray. 

7. Marking — Shall be according to 7 of IS : 4033-1968. 

8. Packing •— Shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer.

IS : 6959- 1973 

4.4 Scissors shall be free from cracks, seams, burrs, flaws and other defects. 

4.5 The surfaces of the scissors shall be finished smooth, passivated and polished bright. 

4.6 The edges shall be even and rounded except for the cutting edge which shall be sharp and shall not have 
any feather. 

5. Heat Treatment — Scissors shall be evenly hardened and tempered to 400 to 460 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance — The scissors shall cut wet tissue paper, teased-out cotton wool, fine hairs and frayed 
lint accurately and cleanly from pinch to tip. 

6.2 Bone Cutting Test — Cut a fresh piece of rib of a sheep or goat. The rib shall be cut evenly without any 
undue resistance. The length of cut shall be not less than one half the length of the cutting edge. This shall 
be done 5 times. The cuts shall be clean and neat and the cutting edges shall not be damaged. The 
scissors shall continue to function satisfactorily after the test. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance Test — Test the sample In accordance with IS : 7531-1975 • Method for 
boiling and autociaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical Instruments '. The 
sample shall show no sign of corrosion after the test. 

7. Marking •— The scissors shall be marked with the following : 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words 'SS'. 

7.1 /SI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The scissors shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bags, 
avoiding contact with one another.
